products.name: Cognigy
products.note: Conversational AI platform for customer service; GDPR-compliant; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Cognigy is an enterprise software company focused on customer service automation, operating under the name NiCE Cognigy. The company describes itself as powering enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents that work across both voice and chat channels, with a stated emphasis on fast and personalized service delivery in contact center environments.

Cognigy's primary product is a conversational AI platform positioned for enterprise use. The held facts note that the platform is GDPR-compliant and available with EU-hosted options, reflecting a focus on data residency and regulatory considerations that are relevant to European enterprise customers. The product is categorized as an enterprise AI platform with agent orchestration capabilities.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Cognigy at this time.
